name: Trazyn the Infinite
oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Prismatic Gallery — As long as Trazyn is on the battlefield, it has all activated abilities of all artifact cards in your graveyard.
blocked_sentences: Prismatic Gallery — As long as Trazyn is on the battlefield, it has all activated abilities of all artifact cards in your graveyard.

needs.what: a static that gives the permanents it affects (here self_only) every activated ability printed on each card of a given type (Artifact) currently in its controller's graveyard, recomputed continuously as cards enter and leave the graveyard (Necrotic Ooze / Dark Impostor shape, but graveyard-sourced)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_exiled_abilities is the same lending mechanism but reads only cards linked to the source in exile (source.exiled_cards with exiled_by == source); there is no key to point it at the graveyard. grant_ability lends only abilities written in the card's own grantable_abilities, and the gain_activated_abilities op is a one-shot snapshot, not a continuous static over a changing zone
